excerpts.text: Studio 4.0? Open higgsfield.ai → Cinema Studio → select version 4.0 . Cinema Studio 4.0 runs on Seedance 2.5 and adds the Director's Panel for cinematography control, generations with up to 50 references, and clips up to 30 seconds. Director's Panel. A single control surface for the look of the film. Film Setup sets the genre (General, Action, Epic, Drama, Comedy, Horror, Noir), the era (from the 60s to the 2020s), and the tempo: the editing style and cut speed, from Single Shot to Chaotic. Camera selects the camera (including 35mm Film, 8mm Film, and DV Camcorder), the lens (from clean sharp to anamorphic and vintage options), and the aperture, with camera moves including POV, Robot Arm, and Helicopter Shot. Color Palette applies one of 50+ color grading templates. Lighting offers 6 presets, or a custom setup with control over color, brightness, diffusion, and angle. References and length. A generation takes up to 50 references: your own uploaded images,
